14 &#8211; <span id="xdx_823_zuzFoNxnE0Jh">COMMITMENTS, CONTINGENCIES AND LEGAL MATTERS</span></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company is subject to claims and litigation in the ordinary course of business. Management does not believe that any such claim or litigation
will have a material adverse effect on the business, assets, or results of operations of the Company.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company had an agreement with 21st Mortgage under which 21st Mortgage provided financing for home purchasers in the Company&#8217;s communities.
The Company did not receive referral fees or other cash compensation under the agreement. If 21st Mortgage made loans to purchasers and
those purchasers defaulted on their loans and 21st Mortgage repossessed the homes securing such loans, the Company agreed to purchase
from 21st Mortgage each such repossessed home for a price equal to <span id="xdx_908_ecustom--RangeOfPurchasePriceRepossessed_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--TwentyFirstMortgageCorporationMember_zRA5pl5AXcoi" title="Range of purchase price repossessed"><ix:nonFraction name="UMH:RangeOfPurchasePriceRepossessed" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_srt_MinimumMember_custom_TwentyFirstMortgageCorporationMember" id="Fact002939" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">80</ix:nonFraction></span>% to <span id="xdx_907_ecustom--RangeOfPurchasePriceRepossessed_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--TwentyFirstMortgageCorporationMember_zcuIAsWyEEql" title="Range of purchase price repossessed"><ix:nonFraction name="UMH:RangeOfPurchasePriceRepossessed" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_srt_MaximumMember_custom_TwentyFirstMortgageCorporationMember" id="Fact002941" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">95</ix:nonFraction></span>% of the amount under each such loan, subject to certain
adjustments. As of December 31, 2025, the total loan balance under this agreement was approximately $<span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--InvestmentOwnedBalancePrincipalAmount_iI_pn5n6_c20251231__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--TwentyFirstMortgageCorporationMember_zOaMtPKWbrXj" title="Investment owned balance principal amount"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:InvestmentOwnedBalancePrincipalAmount" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_TwentyFirstMortgageCorporationMember" id="Fact002943" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.9</ix:nonFraction></span> million. Additionally, 21st
Mortgage previously made loans to purchasers in certain communities we acquired. In conjunction with these acquisitions, the Company
has agreed to purchase from 21st Mortgage each repossessed home, if those purchasers default on their loans. The purchase price ranges
from <span id="xdx_905_ecustom--RangeOfPurchasePriceRepossessed_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__us-gaap--OtherCommitmentsAxis__custom--PurchasePriceMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--TwentyFirstMortgageCorporationMember_zUYDYpCySmu4" title="Range of purchase price repossessed"><ix:nonFraction name="UMH:RangeOfPurchasePriceRepossessed" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_srt_MinimumMember_custom_PurchasePriceMember_custom_TwentyFirstMortgageCorporationMember" id="Fact002945" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">55</ix:nonFraction></span>% to <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--RangeOfPurchasePriceRepossessed_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember__us-gaap--OtherCommitmentsAxis__custom--PurchasePriceMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--TwentyFirstMortgageCorporationMember_zzCJMP9EyBP5" title="Range of purchase price repossessed"><ix:nonFraction name="UMH:RangeOfPurchasePriceRepossessed" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_srt_MaximumMember_custom_PurchasePriceMember_custom_TwentyFirstMortgageCorporationMember" id="Fact002947" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">100</ix:nonFraction></span>% of the amount under each such loan, subject to certain adjustments. As of December 31, 2025, the total loan balance
owed to 21st Mortgage with respect to homes in these acquired communities was approximately $<span id="xdx_907_ecustom--LoanBalance_iI_c20251231__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--TwentyFirstMortgageCorporationMember_zU4dKA9mf4rg" title="Investment owned balance"><ix:nonFraction name="UMH:LoanBalance" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_TwentyFirstMortgageCorporationMember" id="Fact002949" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">406,000</ix:nonFraction></span>. This program was terminated on
June 22, 2023. The Company&#8217;s repurchase obligations for the outstanding loans that were originated by 21st Mortgage remain in effect.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company entered into a Manufactured Home Retailer Agreement (the &#8220;MHRA&#8221;) with 21st Mortgage on January 24, 2023, under which
21st Mortgage provides financing for home purchasers in the Company&#8217;s communities. 21st Mortgage has no recourse against the Company
under the MHRA except in instances where the Customer defaults before two scheduled monthly payments are paid by the purchaser and the
default is based on any dispute between S&amp;F and the purchaser surrounding the terms or execution of the purchase and sale of the
home. Upon such a default, S&amp;F is to take assignment of the loan from 21st Mortgage for the unpaid principal balance plus accrued
interest. As of December 31, 2025, no loans have been originated under the MHRA.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">S&amp;F
entered into a Chattel Loan Origination, Sale and Servicing Agreement (&#8220;COP Program&#8221;) with Triad Financial Services, effective
January 1, 2016. Neither the Company, nor S&amp;F, receive referral fees or other cash compensation under the agreement. If the loan
is approved under the COP Program, then it is originated by Triad, purchased by S&amp;F and then assigned by S&amp;F to the Company.

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8A1_z9xWHbJrsuTa" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
addition to the Company&#8217;s investment in marketable securities at fair value, the Company is required to disclose certain information
about fair values of its other financial instruments, as defined in ASC 825-10, Financial Instruments. Estimates of fair value are made
at a specific point in time, based upon, where available, relevant market prices and information about the financial instrument. Such
estimates do not include any premium or discount that could result from offering for sale at one time the Company&#8217;s entire holdings
of a particular financial instrument. All of the Company&#8217;s marketable securities have quoted market prices. However, for a portion
of the Company&#8217;s other financial instruments, no quoted market value exists. Therefore, estimates of fair value are necessarily
based on a number of significant assumptions (many of which involve events outside the control of management). Such assumptions include
assessments of current economic conditions, perceived risks associated with these financial instruments and their counterparties, future
expected loss experience and other factors. Given the uncertainties surrounding these assumptions, the reported fair values represent
estimates only and, therefore, cannot be compared to the historical accounting model. Use of different assumptions or methodologies is
likely to result in significantly different fair value estimates.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
fair value of cash and cash equivalents and notes receivable approximates their current carrying amounts since all such items are short-term
in nature. The fair value of variable rate loans payable approximate their current carrying amounts since such amounts payable are at
approximately a weighted-average current market rate of interest. As of December 31, 2025, the estimated fair value of fixed rate mortgages
